news.title: Eclipse 2026 Registration Surge: Over 850 Delegates Checked In
news.excerpt: Student delegations from 35 regional institutions have confirmed participation in National Science Eclipse 2026. Online category slots are filling rapidly.
news.fullContent:
Live Dispatch from Central Secretariat:

Participation for the National Science Eclipse 2026 has crossed 850 registered delegates within the first cohort round! Teams are finalizing project abstracts for the Future Idea Showcase.

Ensure your school or college delegation submits credentials before the phase deadline.

news.title: National Science Eclipse 2026 Syllabus
news.excerpt: The Executive Council has officially approved the operational guidelines and syllabus for National Science Eclipse 2026 (16–18 April 2026). Segments include Project Displays, Future Idea Showcase, and Scientific Olympiads.
news.fullContent:
Announcement from United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR):

We are excited to unveil the official structure for our 3-day flagship festival — National Science Eclipse 2026, taking place from 16 to 18 April 2026.

Students from schools, colleges, and polytechnic institutes will compete across 14 scientific categories. Major highlights include the Future Idea Showcase, working hardware project displays, and theoretical problem-solving olympiads.

Online team registrations and student delegate enrolments are now officially open on our web portal.

news.title: Campus Ambassador Recruitment: Cohort 2026
news.excerpt: UYFSR is actively seeking passionate student ambassadors across secondary schools, higher secondary colleges, and universities to lead scientific culture and research initiatives on their campus.
news.fullContent:
Official Call for Campus Ambassadors — Cohort 2026:

Do you want to represent the United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR) at your institution? We are now recruiting dedicated student representatives nationwide!

As a Campus Ambassador, you will:
• Lead science clubs and workshop delegations at your institution
• Receive an official Appointment Letter & verified digital E-Pass
• Gain priority invitations to national fairs, awards, and secretarial symposia
• Earn verified leadership credentials and letters of recommendation

Apply now through the registration portal or email us at uyfsr.org@gmail.com.

news.title: KIDLON Presents Junior Talent Award Season 1
news.excerpt: UYFSR joins TWIMBOL as Community Partner for the Junior Talent Award Season 1, kicking off 18 July 2026. Presented by Venue Partner KIDLON across a 21-day youth talent discovery journey.
news.fullContent:
Partnership Announcement:

United Youth Forum of Science and Research (UYFSR) is honored to partner with TWIMBOL for the nationwide launch of "KIDLON Presents Junior Talent Award – Season 1", scheduled for 18 July 2026.

This 21-day structured initiative will discover and empower young researchers and analytical minds across schools and colleges. Hosted with support from our Venue Partner KIDLON.

news.title: Executive Council & Secretariat Appointments
news.excerpt: The Executive Council has ratified appointments for advisors and departmental secretariats for the 2025–2026 term. Appointed members can access the internal Executive Dashboard using their verified credentials.
news.fullContent:
Executive Council Notification:

Executive Council ratifications have officially concluded for the 2025–2026 academic cycle. Congratulations to all appointed advisors, departmental secretariats, and committee heads.

Appointed officers may now log into the Executive Portal using their official name.

news.title: Junior Startup Challenge: Season 1 Announced
news.excerpt: Calling young innovators and makers: Pitch your scientific hardware prototypes, green tech designs, and digital innovations on 3 September 2026 in collaboration with TWIMBOL.
news.fullContent:
Innovation Announcement:

Bridging scientific research and real-world societal impact! UYFSR is collaborating with TWIMBOL for the "Junior Startup Challenge – Season 1", taking place on 3 September 2026.
